Jack, I support 10 tons each, and I’ll commit to that limit this month. Luke, I appreciate your offer to take nothing, but you deserve a share too. Let’s keep the total at 50 tons so the lake replenishes fully and all five families can count on income next month.

If we ever start a month below 100 tons, we should agree on smaller shares before fishing, leaving at least half the stock to rebuild. Kate, would you join us in the 10-ton agreement?
